earlier: species first recorded <=2010, based on source2001-2024
comparison: observed minus family-degree-null mean, for each period; then difference(new minus earlier); primary sensitivity restrict both periods to species with at least one both-island pair in each period and weight species equally
null: same199 family-preserving MCMC network draws using identical seed, input edge order and swapping algorithm; retain fixed unresolved-family edges
limits: Exploratory retrospective comparison, not arrival or causal transport. Common species need not have identical island pairs. Geography, effort and time-window coverage differ. Plant distribution is pooled2001-2024.
